description: Agent Operations: submit one purchase record for paid content or access (what was bought, price, date, payment reference, the paying agent and the person it bought for) with the seller’s access terms as supplied and, where useful, a date to hold the access against. The signed report states what the buyer holds: whether access continues after purchase and for how long, whether it extends to the buyer’s human or only the paying agent where the terms say, the conditions on it, and the proof to keep to re-establish access later. Terms analysis on supplied records; the content is never retrieved and the seller never contacted. Verdict access_ended, terms_unclear, access_limited or access_continues. POST /api/paid-access-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-operations/.

as_of.description: The date to hold the access against, as YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

asset.description: Asset or currency code, such as USDC or USD.

buyer.description: The paying agent, account or wallet.

on_behalf_of.description: The person the agent bought for.

text.description: The seller’s access terms as supplied.

name: wever_paid-access-check
title: Paid access check
